description: This file defines the ArticlesController class for handling HTTP requests related to article operations in an ASP.NET Core Web API. It includes endpoints for fetching articles, article feeds, article details, creation, editing, and deletion, utilizing MediatR for command/query dispatching.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing article-related HTTP endpoints, utilizing dependency injection for IMediator and securing certain actions with authorization schemes.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of articles based on optional filters like tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a personalized feed of articles for authenticated users, with optional filters.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by slug, requiring authorization.

calls: mediator.Send(new List.Query(tag, author, favorited, limit, offset), cancellationToken)
mediator.Send(new List.Query(tag, author, favorited, limit, offset) { IsFeed = true }, cancellationToken)
